lines: A single glass marble was dropped
I chased after it, and another one fell
In a patch of sunlight meant for one
Only one remains
When my heart first started beating
Whether I liked it or not, I took up a place in the world
So it wouldn't be taken from me, I've kept guarding it
I've kept it unsoiled all this time
But even my hands looked stained
Before I could doubt my memory
My memory was doubting me
We're bound to meet someday
Using the sound of the same heartbeat as our mark
I'm here
I'm calling out to you, always
When our worn-out reasons
Pile up and tremble together
We'll know why we were born
As long as my existence goes on
I have no choice but to take up a place
In a patch of sunlight meant for one
Two of us just won't fit
A single glass marble was dropped
When it fell, it knocked something loose
In the place I seized, I bathed in the light
The footprints I counted
Before I knew it were nothing but numbers
What I need to know
Seems to lie somewhere between one and zero
For the first time, we'll meet
Using the flag of the same scream as our mark
Don't forget
I'm calling out to you, always
When the two of us bury the reasons we've piled up
A promise is exchanged
We're mirrors, each of us to the other
Made to reflect our own karma
With stained hands touching stained hands
I can feel its shape
I'm here — you can touch me, really touch me
In a patch of sunlight meant for one, we both are
Don't forget
I'm calling out to you, always
From inside the same glass marble
Yes — we're bound to meet someday
When we raise a cross over the reasons we sank
The promise will be fulfilled
We will become one
